changelog.reason: High-momentum-scored candidates underperformed low-momentum ones (doubled 11% vs 18%, up50 14% vs 26%); likely chasing already-pumped coins near local tops. Lowering weight should favor less-extended entries.

High-holders-scored candidates rugged far more than low-holders ones (90% vs 49% rug rate); component likely rewards inflated/bot-driven holder counts. Lowering weight should reduce exposure to this trap.

High holders-score coins rug 88% vs 56% for low (n=1129); the component rewards inflated holder counts. 38 post-9-30 picks at 0.75 showed no improvement (-$2.34/pick). Hypothesis: lowering to 0.5 shifts picks toward less rug-prone coins. Confirm if the next ~20 picks have fewer stop-losses (<45%) and better P&L per pick; undo if not.
